news_items.headline: Barclays maintains Hold rating on Biogen
news_items.summary: Barclays reiterated its Hold rating on BIIB on May 5, 2026, signaling continued caution on near-term setup.

news_items.headline: Canaccord Genuity reiterates Buy rating on Biogen
news_items.summary: Canaccord Genuity stuck with its Buy rating on BIIB on May 4, 2026, citing pipeline and growth-product momentum.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Barclays maintained Hold (May 5 2026); Canaccord Genuity reiterated Buy (May 4 2026). TipRanks consensus: Moderate Buy (11 buy / 13 hold / 1 sell). Median PT $190; some sources cite $208–$214 12-month avg target.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 reported April 29, 2026 (already priced in): revenue $2.48B, EPS beat, but FY guidance lowered on Apellis acquisition costs and pressure on legacy MS drugs. Growth drivers LEQEMBI ($168M, +74% YoY) and SKYCLARYS ($151M, +22% YoY) flagged as bull case; pending $5.6B Apellis deal and felzartamab Greater China rights ($850M from TJ Biopharma) are next catalyst clusters. Pivotal pipeline readouts beginning fiscal Q2 2026.
